scope: At 320x800 CSS pixels, apply WCAG text-spacing overrides, verify long discovery content does not clip or overflow, and operate the date filter with the keyboard.
initialRegression: Movie synopses were visually clamped to two lines with overflow hidden, clipping content when increased text spacing was applied.
fix: Removed the line clamp and hidden overflow from movie synopsis paragraphs so text can reflow.

verification.environment: Running local app at http://127.0.0.1:5173 with mocked API responses; no database or Docker writes.

limitations: The test is automated browser evidence and does not complete the manual accessibility checklist.
Actual 200%/400% browser zoom, screen-reader speech, physical mobile touch and device behavior remain unverified.
No screenshots, video or trace were retained for the successful runs.
